html:
A jihadist group founded in Maiduguri in northeastern Nigeria in the early 2000s by the preacher Mohammed Yusuf, which began an armed insurgency in 2009 after he was killed in police custody.

Under Abubakar Shekau it attacked police, schools, churches and mosques, and in April 2014 kidnapped 276 schoolgirls from Chibok, which drew world attention. At its height in 2014 it held a large territory. A split in 2016 created a branch loyal to the Islamic State. The war has killed tens of thousands of people and driven millions from their homes, and spread to Niger, Chad and Cameroon around Lake Chad. See also the Sokoto Caliphate it claims to restore.
sum: A jihadist group founded in Maiduguri in northeastern Nigeria in the early 2000s by the preacher Mohammed Yusuf, which began an armed insurgency in 2009 after he was killed in police custody.
